analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price ($697.92) vs SMA5/20/50 ($681.34/$699.77/$714.46) — Trading near the middle band, above short-term SMA5, below mid-term SMA20.
· Position vs SMA100/200 ($675.60/$644.34) — Mid-to-long term trend strength is positive, 8.32% above the 200-day MA.
· 52-Week Position (73.7%) + Historical Context — Currently trading about 6.6% below the 52-week high.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (38.6→49.2) — Exiting oversold territory, approaching neutral zone.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (histo -3.6866→-0.9304) — Improving from bearish territory, maintaining a dead cross.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Mid-band $699.77) — Trading around the middle band, with a narrowing band width of 9.52%.
[Support & Resistance Structure]

· Swing Resistance ($722.03) — Resistance near the upper Bollinger band ($733.09) and R1 ($729.16).
· 5-Day/20-Day High/Low Pattern (Higher Low / Sideways) — Holding the 5-day low confirms a Higher Low, but failing to break the 20-day high indicates a sideways range.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.37x) — Below the 5-day average, indicating low conviction in price movement.
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Accumulation Phase) — Lacking clear direction, maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
